entries.rationale: INACTIVE ORIGINAL AUTHOR PROPOSAL. The full ordinary equation routine distinguishes unchanged species composition/formula indices from quantities/coefficient changes. The existing oxide/sulfide mass-ratio foundation distinguishes a pure product fixed composition from amount/excess, providing the prior composition concept for that distinction. A genuine explicit didactic prerequisite edge is proposed; it does not exist in current normal data. This is not a direct official law-of-constant-proportions claim. Current endpoint source witness is de-hh-chemie-seki-bildungsplan-2014-2018-3-1-uf-j10-017-da29206c. Requires two foreign informed context/dependency reviews; no current source coverage or mastery completion is claimed.
